subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential, scope, subscription, and config contract should become permanent?
rationale: The remaining request changes Google Chat data visibility, consent/scopes, credential storage, event subscription lifecycle, and fallback behavior; source review can prove the gap but cannot choose that security boundary.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define a SecretRef-aware user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, keep service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

options.title: Limit Google Chat To Mentioned Webhooks
options.body: Keep the bundled plugin service-account and mention-triggered only, while finishing thread-reply reliability separately.

options.title: Defer To Broader Workspace Auth
options.body: Hold all-message ingestion until Google Workspace integrations share a common consent, token, subscription, and admin-approval model.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define a SecretRef-aware user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, keep service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from the shipped thread-reply landing and the related Google Chat OAuth maintainer-review context.
